messages:
maya: FYI PR #412 failed CI + ArgoCD sync in prod overlay — manifests referencing a secret that isn't present yet.

ci-bot: GHA job `deploy-prod` failed: ArgoCD wait timed out after 10m. Logs: "manifest apply succeeded but sync failed: secret \"app-credentials\" not found"

kevin: can you paste the GHA workflow snippet and the atlantis workspace layout? wonder if applies are running in parallel.

maya: here's the relevant bits:
```
# .github/workflows/deploy.yml
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: ...
  plan:
    needs: [lint]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: ...
  deploy-prod:
    needs: [plan]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: atlantis apply
        run: atlantis apply -- -target=module.k8s
      - name: wait for argocd
        run: ./scripts/wait-for-argocd-sync.sh
```

maya: Atlantis shows two workspaces touching the same cluster: `infra` and `apps-prod`. Plan succeeded for both but applies kicked off concurrently.

sam: probable root cause: secret is created by `infra` workspace (either via helm chart hook or kubernetes_manifest) and apps-prod applied before it existed.

linda: quick mitigation options:
- run atlantis applies sequentially (infra then apps-prod)
- make the GHA coordinate: add explicit steps `atlantis apply -- -workspace=infra` then `-- -workspace=apps-prod`
- add a preflight job that checks for the secret and blocks until present (`kubectl get secret app-credentials`)

kevin: also consider ArgoCD sync-wave annotations so apps implicitly wait for infra: `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: \"-10\"` on infra resources and `0` on app resources. declarative and avoids fragile CI ordering.

sam: +1 for sync-wave, but CI still needs to wait until ArgoCD reports sync success. current script uses `argocd app wait --timeout 600s` which can time out if infra chart creates the secret via helm hooks that run late.

maya: helm hooks are the kicker — infra helm chart uses a post-install hook to create the secret. any ideas to make the CI wait more robust?

aaron: options I've done before:
- extend argocd wait timeout in CI to 20m for infra->app flows
- update `wait-for-argocd-sync.sh` to loop on the specific secret `kubectl -n prod get secret app-credentials` and then run `argocd app wait`
- change the infra chart to create the secret as a normal manifest instead of a hook

maya: I pushed a small PR changing GHA to apply infra workspace first and then apps-prod, and added a 15m fallback loop that polls for the secret before failing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/418

kevin: nice. can you also add a short comment in atlantis.yaml documenting why workspace ordering matters? saves future confusion.

maya: done in the PR. added an inline comment and a short note in the PR description.

linda: another operational idea — an atlantis post-apply webhook that applies an idempotent `secret-placeholder.yaml` during CI to unblock argocd. only enabled when `CI=true` or similar. risky but pragmatic for urgent deploys.

sam: ok ship the GHA ordering PR now. we'll follow up with sync-wave and chart changes in separate PRs.

kevin: I can review and merge in ~30m.

maya: thanks — I'll queue the deploy after merge. :thumbsup: 

ci-bot: deploy job queued: build 1253. ETA ~10m.

kevin: merged and kicked off CI.

aaron: if it flakes again ping me; I can add a dedicated preflight job that creates the secret idempotently.

maya: will do. thanks everyone. :heart:
